# Inna Gardiner

Inna Gardiner is the current Deputy of [District 4](https://flow.je/elections/district-4) and was first elected to the States of Jersey in 2019.

Inna Gardiner has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2018 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner#e42)

  Not elected.

  - [2018 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2018/inna-gardiner-2/)
  - [2018 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zbHe8fu49G0)
  - [2018 Bailiwick Express Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8DSN_EOli_E)
- [**2019 St Helier No 3 & 4 Deputy By-Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner#e45)

  Elected as Deputy of St Helier No 3 & 4 with 24.4% of the vote.

  - [2019 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2019/inna-gardiner-3/)
  - [2019 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L-lOpBwFaUE)
- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/inna-gardiner#e48)

  Elected as Deputy of District 4 with 70.9% of the ballot.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/inna-gardiner/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TtsDHxtKz_U)
  - [2022 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20220707163112/https://innagardiner.com/)
  - [2022 SCOOP Food Security Questionnaire](https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=1kI5ESEJ4byHHwSp76kLGeBkayQSQynP9#page=13)

Inna Gardiner has declared her intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Connétables Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [St Helier](https://flow.je/elections/st-helier). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/02/former-education-minister-to-stand-for-st-helier-constable/)\]

- [2026 Full Manifesto](https://innagardiner.com/my-manifesto-for-st-helier/)

- Facebook : [@innagardinerpolitician](https://www.facebook.com/innagardinerpolitician)
- Twitter : [@innagardiner](https://twitter.com/innagardiner)

## Election History
